name: XDKNet 3.0.2.0
body:
XDKNet 3.0.2.0 brings every XDKNet server setting into the app's admin area
and gives the plugin's settings page in Jellyfin and Emby a new look. Update
the server plugin to 3.0.2.0 as well; the app finds the new settings once the
plugin has them.

## Settings in the app

- Admin, System, XDKNet now holds every plugin setting: search them, change
  them, and save or discard, the same way as other admin pages. It works on
  TV with the remote, on phones and on the web.
- Keys are set, replaced or removed but never shown. If someone else changed
  a setting while you were editing, you choose which value to keep.
- PINs, Radarr and Sonarr servers, the Home layout, themes, server messages,
  Watch Party rooms, active downloads, the log, storage and per-person tools
  all have their own pages there. Game cores can be uploaded from a phone,
  computer or the browser, with progress.
- XDKNet's Settings button in the Plugins list opens these instead of the web
  page; the web page is still a tap away.

## The plugin's settings page

- Jellyfin and Emby show the same settings, grouped, with search, a Save and
  Discard bar that lists what is unsaved, and a warning before leaving with
  unsaved changes. "Save as Default" is gone.
- Emby gains the settings it was missing, such as the Public Server URL and
  the Seerr webhook's status.

## Safer settings

- The MDBList, TMDB and push keys, the Firebase account and the Seerr webhook
  secret are no longer sent to pages that read the plugin's settings.
- Saves from different places can no longer overwrite each other.
- Restoring the settings backup only works when the settings were lost, and
  keeps your current keys and themes.
- Pushing or copying defaults keeps each person's own Seerr, TMDB and MDBList
  keys and what they hid from Continue Watching and Next Up.
- Busy buttons such as Broadcast and Push to everyone have a short wait
  between uses.

## Invites

- One visitor can no longer slow sign-up for their whole network, people
  behind their own office or carrier proxy can sign up, and a connection
  that changes between opening and sending the form refreshes it instead of
  failing.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
